items.t: Coinbase’s Bank Charter Is Bad News for Circle. Here’s the $1.4 Billion That Matters
items.sum: Key TakeawaysCoinbase announced final approval for a national trust charter on Nov. 9, and it expects to issue and service stablecoins for other firms once OCC stablecoin rules take effect in January.

items.t: Circle Internet Group (CRCL) Expands USDC Payments And Financial Skills Across Africa
items.sum: Circle Internet Group (NYSE:CRCL) announced a multi-year partnership with advocacy organisation Global Citizen focused on Africa. The collaboration introduces USDC payments for local vendors tied to Global Citizen's Move Afrika music and entrepreneurship program.
